headline: Mustard Drowns The League While Stroud Boys Forget Football Exists
subhead: Week 6 served up a 171-burger from Nick, a 37-point execution in Egbukkake's living room, and a Stroud Boys lineup that looked like it was filed by Davis Mills himself.
matchOfTheWeek: QAmon vs McBridesStrangeWhiteHock was the only game this week that didn't end in a curb-stomp — Kyle squeaked by 121.10 to 112.54 while leaving a casual 32.48 points rotting on his bench, including King Unc dropping 18.76 in street clothes. Meanwhile Rocks had Daniel Jones throwing up 23.48 on HIS bench. Two managers playing 4D chess where the goal is to lose pieces. Somehow Kyle wins because Rocks brought even less to the table.
powerRankingsShakeup: Nut Olave Your Face is officially the league bully after dropping 171 AND trading for Saquon — Nick is collecting RBs like Pokémon. Stroud Boys plummet to the league cellar after a 108-piece that not even Cam Skattebo's 31 could save.
mainRecap:
Let's start at the top, because Nick won't let us forget it. Mustard ran for 35.80, My Njigba added 30.20, and then — because subtlety is for poors — he traded for Saquon Barkley mid-massacre. The Good Ladds put up 147 and STILL got dumpstered by 24, which means Mig assembled a top-3 weekly score and walked away with an L and a bench full of Jaydens. Brutal. Kendrick Bourne also dropped 19.2 from the pine because of course he did.

Egbukkake hung 151 on T Swift's Baddies in a game so lopsided it qualifies as a hate crime. Tnicolle got 31.8 from Drake London and the rest of the lineup showed up like it was a bye week. Szara is cooking — Perc Hurts and the Mascot are real, and the 'WR1' Tillman bit is starting to age into actual production.

Little Peckers put up 159 behind Mahomes (31.48), Jacobs (32), and Pickens (31.8), which is the kind of week where you should be celebrating — except Kayshon Boutte dropped 26.3 ON THE BENCH. You won by 19 with a fully loaded gun still in the holster. Rub My Chubb hit 96.6% efficiency and STILL lost, which is the most Big D outcome imaginable.

Matt's Christian McCalfinjury squad beat OnlyFants despite Jaxson Dart unloading 23.6 from the bench — Cubby got 30.5 from Dallas Goedert and somehow scored 122. When your TE is your offense, you're not winning anything.

Browning Out smacked the Stroud Boys 135-108. Bjewett, my guy, Skattebo went for 31 and you still finished dead last in scoring. The Prodigal Son needs to come home because whatever else you're starting is criminal. Money Mill$ couldn't even bail you out this time.
